script: if(!(is_admin)) { error 'This package requires admin rights to install'; break }
if ([environment]::OSVersion.Version.Major -lt 10) { error 'This package requires Windows 10/11 to install'; break }

$headers = @{ 'User-Agent' = 'Mozilla/5.0 (Windows NT 10.0; Win64; x64) AppleWebKit/537.36 Chrome/130.0 Safari/537.36'; 'Referer' = 'https://www.nvidia.com/Download/index.aspx'; 'Accept' = 'application/json, text/plain, */*' }
if ($item.Count -eq 0 -or $null -eq $item[0].downloadInfo) { throw 'NVIDIA did not return a desktop driver result for this lookup.' }
if ($version -notmatch '^\d+(?:\.\d+)+$' -or [string]::IsNullOrWhiteSpace($downloadUrl)) { throw 'NVIDIA desktop driver response is missing a valid version or download URL.' }
